body:
Anna (CS): Morning team — quick sync re: trial ambassador intake for Wave 5 previews. Need to finalize invite email + feedback capture flow by EOD. Can we send invites tomorrow and run a 15-min enablement session next Tue? Also need a 3-question micro-survey and a small prompt set for quality checks.
Mike (Onboarding): I can draft the invite. Do we point to the public "Preview Quickstart" or the sandbox with scoped keys? Who owns the enablement session?
Jamal (SE): Sandbox + scoped API keys preferred. I'll generate scoped keys tonight with format `preview_readonly_<date>`. Uploaded a starter prompt-set to drive: https://drive.redwood/preview/playbooks/ambassador-samples
Sara (CSM): For renewal-risk tagging — mark accounts that skip enablement or don't submit feedback in 7 days as `engagement:at-risk`. I'll create a view in Gainsight to track.
Tom (Eng Ops): I'll tentatively schedule Tue 10:30–10:45 PT for the 15-min kickoff. Will share invites once Mike confirms copy. Also added a reminder automation to ping accounts after 3 days.
Anna (CS): Survey should be tiny: 1) Ease of setup (1–5), 2) Usefulness (1–5), 3) One short comment box. Prefer we send the link after first successful run.
Mike (Onboarding): Agreed. I'll use Linkly for the micro-survey: https://lnk.redwood/nps-preview and wire it into the invite footer and the post-run webhook. Draft invite by 5pm for quick +1s.
Jamal (SE): Webhook snippet — can ops confirm endpoint?

POST https://hooks.redwood/cs-feedback
{
  "customer_id": "{{org_id}}",
  "run_id": "{{run_id}}",
  "survey_url": "{{lnk}}"
}

Sara (CSM): I'll track responses and follow up. Proposal: call top 5 active accounts for 15-min qualitative interviews in week 2.
Tom (Eng Ops): OpsBot: scheduling reminder for wave5 nudge in 3 days. Also note: preview keys created (wave5-ambassador-keys, 12 keys). Check #eng-infra for rotation plan. :robot_face:
OpsBot: preview keys created: wave5-ambassador-keys (12). Reminder automation set.
Anna (CS): Who owns final invite copy? @Mike (Onboarding). Please add a short privacy/data-retention blurb — customers ask.
Mike (Onboarding): On it — will post draft to #customer-success by 17:00 for reviews.
Jamal (SE): I'll add automated eval job: run 50 sample prompts per account after 24h and surface regressions to the quality dashboard.
Sara (CSM): Tagging plan: `engagement:at-risk` / `feedback:missing` / `enablement:missed`. If no feedback in 7 days I'll do targeted outreach.
Anna (CS): Closing loop: Mike = invite copy, Jamal = keys & webhook + eval job, Tom = scheduling + reminders, Sara = tracking + outreach. Quick thumbs? :thumbsup:
Mike (Onboarding): 👍
Jamal (SE): 👍
Sara (CSM): 👍
Tom (Eng Ops): 👍
Anna (CS): Thanks all — will follow up if anything shifts.
